body:
Hi, 

first I want to thank you for your awesome mini library. I've been using some of your mini plugins for some time now, including mini.completion.

I specially like the "one-line" signature help, because on other plugins I tried, this kind of feature mostly gives you the full blown help description as well which takes away real estate. But in my workflow at least, I have to know/look-up a function anyway before using it and all I need is the reminder about arguments, their type and order.

---

There is one thing that has been bugging me for a while and I hope you could help me with what I'm doing wrong.

Basically the mini.completion's signature help is rendering some special characters weirdly. E.g. below (first image) the closing parenthesis and the underscore are highlighted in red when compared to `vim.lsp.buf.signature_help` (second image). Also the markdown characters like ` `` ` (backticks) and `*` are hidden in `vim.lsp.buf.signature_help` and `vim.lsp.buf.hover` (third image) while they are visible in mini.completion.

This is my nvim config: https://github.com/myzb/dotfiles/tree/master/.config/nvim

mini.completion signature help:
![Screenshot From 2024-12-22 12-57-26](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4dd1e133-23e5-4fc3-ab39-d19cc29f8ce7)

vim.lsp.buf.signature_help:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9994e4f6-a83d-4055-9128-ba3e1b50ebf3)


vim.lsp.buf.hover:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/be6e573d-b592-4f9b-92c8-768cf04f7cc4)

Could you help me finding what I'm doing wrong?

Thank you a lot!
myzb
title: [Q/Help] mini.completion: weird markdown render in signature help vs lsp.signature_help
